read.thesis: Record 3.8Mt steel shipments at 92% utilisation vs 80% industry, realized price up $102/t and flat-rolled spreads above $230/t; aluminum mill ramp slipped, with H2 EBIT-positive now "not likely".

capex.quote: Capital investment -- $150 million in the third quarter, with an additional $150 million estimated for the fourth quarter.

triggers.label: Realised steel price up $102/t
triggers.quote: average selling prices per ton increased $102

triggers.label: Supply chain inventories very lean
triggers.quote: inventory levels throughout the supply chain remain very lean and order lead times are elevated

triggers.label: Q4 outages remove 1-1.2Mt
triggers.quote: Q4 outages probably is going to take 1 million, 1.2 million tons out of the marketplace

triggers.label: Aluminum H2 EBIT positive 'not likely'
triggers.quote: for the second half of the year, in totality, given the experience that we had in the third quarter, I don't think it's likely

guidance.quote: we still believe we can achieve 90% by the end of the year
through-cycle EBITDA expectation for past-normalized market conditions remains at $650 million to $700 million
Right now, for CapEx next year, it might be in the range of $600-plus million, but that needs to be refined.
